ledger_entry_proposal.title: CSS pow NaN and unit-magnitude infinite-exponent handling

Original and final runs complete 147 callbacks: all 18 targets improve, all 24 authored callbacks pass, and 129 control plus two ending signatures remain unchanged. Final installed execution has no failures or unexpected results. Historical Hypot 149 and round 145 source/commit metadata remain unchanged; current calc b291d6e9 explicitly supersedes b7a6ac85. Shared-branch validation retains the held provider. Abstract guard/folding, binary32 classification and scalar checks support bounded claims; they do not establish native powf correctness, correct rounding, full CSS conformance, clean-upstream execution or canonical coverage credit.
proposed_roadmap_next: Preserve the exact pow source/WPT and removed metadata in future restoration and build lineage. Contextual easing remains unaccepted despite its successful 315-case comparison and isolated Servo checks; its fixed-association ownership model does not establish native refinement. Future discovery requires separate evidence and deduplication; no additional bug or proof credit is granted here.
scope_limitations: The scalar helper handles CSS exceptional-value guards and delegates all other inputs to existing powf.
The shared branch includes the held provider; no clean-upstream execution is claimed.
Abstract expression folding and binary32 classification proofs do not prove native powf, correct rounding, or all CSS calculations.
The twelve captured expected failures are observed targets; bounded prior-art research does not establish a unique newly filed native bug.
